headline: Punjab GST Amendment Bill 2026 passed: Big relief for businesses, credit note and refund rules to become easier - GST relief on post sale discounts tax liability will be reduced with credit note | GST relief on post-sale discounts: tax liability to be reduced with credit note
summary: The Punjab GST Amendment Bill 2026 has been passed. The government says the changes align with the Finance Act 2026 and will reduce tax disputes and make GST processes smoother.
why: GST is India's federal goods and services tax, and state-level rule changes affect compliance costs and cash flows for businesses.
